11 years Increase child age 0 Decrease child age + Add a room Special codes Travel Industry ID Group code Corporate code Promo code Search A resort in China where ancient meets modern and a mighty Tao mountain Six Senses Qing Cheng Mountain spa resort in China is located right at the picturesque gateway to the UNESCO World Heritage & Natural Cultural site in nearby Dujiangyan. Its regional architecture and landscaping bring you an extraordinary cultural offering combined with a contemporary and eco-friendly twist. Its award-winning spa administers Taoism's healing powers while aligning your qi. Illustration of a person with animals such as a cat, deer, owl, fish, crab, turtle, and bird among diverse plants and rocks in harmony with nature.
